amos.5.p1.b1.text: Hear this word, O house of Israel, this lamentation I take up against you: “Fallen is Virgin Israel, never to rise again. She lies abandoned on her land, with no one to raise her up.”

amos.5.p1.b2.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: “The city that marches out a thousand strong will only see a hundred return, and the one that marches out a hundred strong will have but ten left in the house of Israel.”

amos.5.p1.b3.text: For this is what the LORD says to the house of Israel: “Seek Me and live! Do not seek Bethel or go to Gilgal; do not journey to Beersheba, …

amos.5.p1.b4.text: There are those who turn justice into wormwood and cast righteousness to the ground.

amos.5.p1.b5.text: He who made the Pleiades and Orion, who turns darkness into dawn and darkens day into night, … the LORD is His name—

amos.5.p1.b6.text: For I know that your transgressions are many and your sins are numerous. You oppress the righteous by taking bribes; you deprive the poor of justice in the gate.

amos.5.p2.b1.text: Hate evil and love good; establish justice in the gate. Perhaps the LORD, the God of Hosts, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.”

amos.5.p2.b2.text: There will be wailing in all the vineyards, for I will pass through your midst,” says the LORD.

amos.5.p2.b3.text: Woe to you who long for the Day of the LORD! What will the Day of the LORD be for you?

amos.5.p2.b4.text: It will be like a man who flees from a lion, only to encounter a bear, or who enters his house and rests his hand against the wall, only to be bitten by a snake.

amos.5.p2.b5.text: “I hate, I despise your feasts! … Take away from Me the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.

amos.5.p2.b6.text: But let justice roll on like a river, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.

amos.5.p2.b7.text: You have taken along Sakkuth your king and Kaiwan your star god, the idols you made for yourselves. Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Damascus,” says the LORD
